dossiers.name: Fluidstack Abernathy Data Center
dossiers.summary: A purpose built AI campus at Abernathy, north of Lubbock, developed by TeraWulf with Fluidstack and backed financially by Google. The state certified Anthropic as its qualifying occupant. It is one of two unrelated data center campuses in the same small town.

facts.label: TeraWulf ownership of the joint venture
Location
facts.text: Abernathy, Hale County, north of Lubbock

facts.label: Delivery
facts.text: Expected in the second half of 2026

notes.text: The Comptroller certified Anthropic, PBC as qualifying occupant. TeraWulf's own release places an Anthropic lease at a different campus and describes its majority interest in the Abernathy joint venture as sold to Fluidstack. Both statements can be true about different things and this record does not adjudicate between them.
Google is the financial anchor rather than a tenant, backstopping the lease obligations so the project could raise debt.

Cooling design is not public
